item.title: No. 13 Purdue escapes with OT win over No. 7 Nebraska
item.description: No. 13 Purdue defeated No. 7 Nebraska 80-77 in overtime, with Oscar Cluff's layup and Gicarri Harris' two free throws sealing the victory.

item.title: Shootings at British Columbia school and home leave 10 dead, 25 injured
item.description: Shootings at a school and a home in British Columbia left 10 people dead, including the suspect. More than 25 were injured.

item.title: Federal exploitation charges filed in death of Fishers teen Hailey Buzbee
item.description: Tyler Thomas, a 39-year-old Columbus man, has been charged with sexually exploiting a minor and traveling interstate with the intent to engage in illicit sexual conduct related to the disappearance of 17-year-old Hailey Buzbee, and faces up to 30 years in prison for each charge.

item.title: Plainfield’s Thomas H. Little House damaged in accidental fire
item.description: The Thomas H. Little House, a circa 1885 home in Plainfield, Indiana, was damaged in an accidental fire on Tuesday. Plainfield Fire Territory says the Queen Anne-style house had been recently remodeled after being moved in 2024 to its current location.

item.title: Popular athleisure brand Lululemon expands to Indiana Premium Outlets
